dashboard.title: API Operations Command
dashboard.description: Operator dashboard for latency, errors, route degradation, and policy outcomes using MVP-safe summaries plus one request-level evidence table from the live normalized table.

options.content:
## API Operations Command
Current-vs-prior-window latency and error evidence for route owners. Policy-derived dimensions can legitimately show `unknown` when optional auth or DS2 security context is absent.

panels.title: Error Rate %
panels.description: Claim: gateway stability is measurable without billing or custom logs. Evidence: merged 5xx and `gateway_error` outcome share. Provenance: overview summary from normalized response codes and outcomes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, toUInt16(response_status_code) >= 500 OR gateway_outcome = 'gateway_error')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS value
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Operations Error Rate; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: p95 Latency
panels.description: Claim: route degradation should surface as p95 movement, not only averages. Evidence: merged p95 gateway latency. Provenance: normalized `gateway_latency_ms` from plugin duration.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(ifNull(quantileTDigestMerge(0.95)(`quantileTDigest(0.95)(gateway_latency_ms)`), 0), 1) AS value
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Operations p95 Latency; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Auth Rejected %
panels.description: Claim: authentication failures deserve separate operational handling from policy denials. Evidence: merged `auth_rejected` share. Provenance: transform-derived `auth_outcome`, which may be `unknown` on sparse rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, auth_outcome = 'auth_rejected')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS value
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Operations Auth Rejected Rate; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Rate Limited %
panels.description: Claim: throttling pressure should be visible separately from hard failures. Evidence: merged `rate_limited` share. Provenance: transform-derived `rate_limit_outcome` with sparse-safe fallback.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, rate_limit_outcome = 'rate_limited')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS value
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Operations Rate Limited Share; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Error Rate Trend
panels.description: Claim: degradation should show as a time trend, not just a point metric. Evidence: merged error share by minute. Provenance: overview summary only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, toUInt16(response_status_code) >= 500 OR gateway_outcome = 'gateway_error')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS error_rate_pct
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Operations Error Rate Trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Gateway Outcomes Over Time
panels.description: Claim: operators need to separate served traffic from protection and failure outcomes. Evidence: per-minute merged outcome counts. Provenance: transform-derived outcome categories from the overview summary.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome = 'served') AS served,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome = 'policy_denied') AS policy_denied,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome = 'rate_limited') AS rate_limited,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome = 'auth_rejected') AS auth_rejected,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome = 'gateway_error') AS gateway_error
FROM ${overview_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Operations Gateway Outcomes Trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Routes Ranked by p95 Degradation
panels.description: Claim: route degradation needs baseline context. Evidence: current-vs-prior-window p95 latency delta by route group. Provenance: overview summary only; baseline window equals the selected window length immediately before the current range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(
      dateDiff('second', toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})) + 1,
      1
    ) AS secs
  ),
  current_window AS (
    SELECT
      route_group,
      countMerge(`count()`) AS current_requests,
      ifNull(quantileTDigestMerge(0.95)(`quantileTDigest(0.95)(gateway_latency_ms)`), 0) AS current_p95_ms
    FROM ${overview_summary}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND route_group != 'unknown'
    GROUP BY route_group
  ),
  baseline_window AS (
    SELECT
      route_group,
      ifNull(quantileTDigestMerge(0.95)(`quantileTDigest(0.95)(gateway_latency_ms)`), 0) AS baseline_p95_ms
    FROM ${overview_summary}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL (SELECT secs FROM duration) SECOND
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND route_group != 'unknown'
    GROUP BY route_group
  )
SELECT
  coalesce(c.route_group, b.route_group) AS route_group,
  c.current_requests,
  round(c.current_p95_ms, 1) AS current_p95_ms,
  round(coalesce(b.baseline_p95_ms, 0), 1) AS baseline_p95_ms,
  round(c.current_p95_ms - coalesce(b.baseline_p95_ms, 0), 1) AS p95_delta_ms
FROM current_window AS c
FULL OUTER JOIN baseline_window AS b ON c.route_group = b.route_group
ORDER BY p95_delta_ms DESC, current_p95_ms DESC
LIMIT 15
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Operations Route p95 Degradation; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Recent Request Evidence
panels.description: Claim: summaries are not enough for last-mile triage. Evidence: request-level normalized rows preserving route, latency, and policy context. Provenance: raw `zuplo_gateway` table using only implemented transform fields.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  request_id,
  route_group,
  response_status_code,
  gateway_latency_ms,
  gateway_outcome,
  ifNull(nullIf(auth_outcome, ''), 'unknown') AS auth_outcome,
  ifNull(nullIf(rate_limit_outcome, ''), 'unknown') AS rate_limit_outcome,
  ifNull(nullIf(akamai_security_policy, ''), 'none') AS policy_name,
  ifNull(nullIf(akamai_security_deny_group, ''), 'none') AS akamai_edge_action
FROM ${table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Operations Recent Request Evidence; du=${__user.login}'
